look.why: A soft pink, the complement of the leaf green, that makes the red eyes and orange toes glow.

size.measure: snout to vent: 4–7 cm, females larger

habitat.text: Rainforests near ponds, from southern Mexico to northern South America.

diet.text: Flies, mosquitoes, grasshoppers and other bugs, snapped up at night.

facts.text: Unborn tadpoles can hatch early and drop into the water if a snake attacks their eggs!
It flashes its big red eyes to startle a hungry predator.
